prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate exactly ONE high-fidelity, legible Simplified Chinese DooKnow desktop UI design, approximately 1536×1024, no browser/device frame, no presentation captions. Image 1 is the matching REAL pre-redesign baseline: its content, visible actions, user role and selected state are authoritative. Image 2 PILOT-WS-001 is STYLE ONLY: use its restrained blue #4566c6, white #ffffff, light-gray #f7f8fa, text #272b3a, muted #657084, fine #e6e9f1 dividers, 8px radii, clear typographic density and aligned flat surfaces. Do not transfer its owner rail, notebook tree, empty-note state, or unrelated actions.
ROLE BOUNDARY: this is a standalone authorization/public share page. NO owner avatar/rail/sidebar/private note tree/settings/apps/recent/favorites/trash navigation. NO blog navigation unless explicitly present. Preserve only this baseline's role-specific brand/header/footer and content. No ToDoo brand/task/calendar content, teams/members, AI chat, social login, password gate, upload/publish controls, fabricated counts/success/connected state. No API/contract/developer metadata or requestId/version/hash/cursor/nonce/CSRF fields in UI. One coherent state only, no simultaneous overlays or all-state dashboard. Preserve conditional controls and real enabled/disabled guards. Treat exact source templates as authority and make existing primary actions reachable; do not shrink legibility.
SELECTED PAGE:
STANDALONE OAUTH CONSENT. Preserve actual baseline legacy scope flow, request loaded and not busy, not the alternate domain-policy editor. Center an approximately640px width authorization column on white canvas; no owner chrome. Existing blue open-book DooKnow brand above the card. Card title 连接 DooKnow. Client identity panel with lock icon, small label 连接请求来自, exact synthetic client name 隔离界面盘点客户端; do not add trusted/verified badges. Intro 请选择此连接允许的业务能力与资源范围。 Section 允许的操作 with one CHECKED checkbox 读取所选目录中的资料. Section 允许的资料目录 with exactly nine CHECKED checkbox rows, folder icons and labels in order: README.md, 00-Inbox, 10-Projects, 20-Areas, 30-Knowledge, 40-Resources, 50-Journal, 90-Archive, 99-System. Keep fine separators and clear compact rows. Restrained information note with lock icon: 未选择的业务能力和资源不会开放。可随时在 MCP 设置中收窄或撤销连接。 Footer buttons 拒绝 neutral and 允许访问 primary, enabled as baseline valid selection. Below the card retain existing note 仅在你确认后，连接才能访问所选资料。 Use slightly longer vertical canvas if needed to keep bottom buttons/note visible, no smaller type. Source permissionPolicy is absent in selected baseline: do not display business domain switches, all-resource selectors or advanced controls. offline_access was not requested in baseline: do not invent 保持连接 checkbox. No protocol query/client-id/CSRF input, no private navigation.

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。
